the depolarization of the Ka-band satellite signal in a thunderstorm event has a good correlation with the occurrence of lightning strokes.
the rapid changes in XPD and cross-polarization phase are often observed in thunderstorm events, and that the rapid changes are often accompanied by lightning strokes.
